additional_text: p ma kubʼ tzʼuneʼ, ma kubʼ ttzʼunbʼaʼn raíz tzʼun p

examples.example_maya: Tzʼunl tkubʼ jun kuch tuj jbʼal, tuʼnj kʼaloʼn
